channel.title: The daily tape · compute.world
channel.description: A day after the Financial Times reported that Nvidia told Dell, Supermicro and other partners to stop shipping AI servers to Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand and Indonesia, Singapore's Deputy Prime Minister Gan Kim Yong said on 27 November the halt has not been confirmed and that Singapore is reviewing its regulations and monitoring so it does not become a conduit for illegal trade. Equinix and Digital Realty played down the impact, but Natixis estimates nearly a third of operational capacity across the four markets is linked to Chinese owners or tenants, above 45% in Malaysia and Thailand. In the US the cost of capital is splitting by customer: Bloomberg reported banks are preparing a $4.5 billion CoreWeave loan backed by its Meta contract at about 7% to 7.5%, while CoreWeave's unsecured 2031 notes yielded near 18% and its five-year CDS hit 15.34%. List prices held for a fifteenth straight tape day: 70 confirms, 0 ticks, 0 NEW, with Lambda H100 at $4.59 and B200 at $7.69 and Crusoe's 1 December step-up due Tuesday.

item.title: Compute brief - 27 November 2026
item.description: A day after the Financial Times reported that Nvidia told Dell, Supermicro and other partners to stop shipping AI servers to Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand and Indonesia, Singapore's Deputy Prime Minister Gan Kim Yong said on 27 November the halt has not been confirmed and that Singapore is reviewing its regulations and monitoring so it does not become a conduit for illegal trade. Equinix and Digital Realty played down the impact, but Natixis estimates nearly a third of operational capacity across the four markets is linked to Chinese owners or tenants, above 45% in Malaysia and Thailand. In the US the cost of capital is splitting by customer: Bloomberg reported banks are preparing a $4.5 billion CoreWeave loan backed by its Meta contract at about 7% to 7.5%, while CoreWeave's unsecured 2031 notes yielded near 18% and its five-year CDS hit 15.34%. List prices held for a fifteenth straight tape day: 70 confirms, 0 ticks, 0 NEW, with Lambda H100 at $4.59 and B200 at $7.69 and Crusoe's 1 December step-up due Tuesday. Countries: Singapore: DPM Gan says Nvidia shipment halt not verified; Singapore reviewing anti-diversion regulation and monitoring and engaging the US on chip access for US hyperscalers (Wire, 27 Nov). Malaysia: Peninsular power demand projected from 22.6 GW in 2027 to 49.8 GW by 2050, data centres rising from 11% to 21% of load; Natixis says over 45% of live capacity is China-linked (Wire, 26 to 27 Nov). United States: $4.5 billion Meta-linked CoreWeave GPU loan at about 7% to 7.5% versus near 18% on unsecured notes (single-source); FCC authorizes SpaceX Starmind; EIA proposes data centre energy survey (Wire, 25 to 27 Nov). Japan: JERA in talks with Meta, Anthropic, Google, Microsoft and Amazon to site data centres at Tokyo-area thermal plants (Wire, 27 Nov, single-source). Kuwait: KIA's Wren House buys GIC's 80% stake in Equinix's European xScale JV, completing Q1 2027 (Wire, 27 Nov). India: Telangana targets 5 GW of data centre capacity by 2029 from 300 MW live (Wire, 26 Nov). Netherlands: Trade minister urges US not to enforce MATCH Act on ASML and weighs EU countermeasures (Wire, 27 Nov, single-source). Belgium: Construction halted at Google's Farciennes campus after work continued on a revoked, water-linked permit (Wire, 27 Nov). Kenya: Vodafone plans to triple Safaricom's data centre footprint to 35 MW for sovereign AI and GPU-as-a-service (Wire, 27 Nov).
